responsibility: Provides generic tree/GIMPLE data-flow support routines that are shared across SSA-based passes rather than implementing one analysis pass itself. It handles statement-UID renumbering, variable and DFA statistics dumping, default-definition bookkeeping, decomposition of references and addresses into base-plus-offset form, detection and repair of abnormal-PHI SSA uses, and declaration-enumeration dumping used by debugging, SSA maintenance, and CFG transformations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the reusable tree/GIMPLE data-flow helpers declared in tree-dfa.h, such as statement-UID renumbering, variable/DFA dumping, abnormal-SSA repair, declaration enumeration, and base-plus-offset decomposition routines.
